import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor')

nf, slots = 8, 2

preds=[]
for c in range(nf*slots):
    f=fields[c%nf]['name']; s=c//nf
    preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':fields[c%nf]['type']}})
    preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[s,f]},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1,'type':fields[c%nf]['type']}})
rows=[]
for ones in [(a,b) for a in range(16) for b in range(a+1,16)]:
    row=[1 if c in ones else 0 for c in range(16)]
    rows.append([row[i*nf:(i+1)*nf] for i in range(slots)])
rng=random.Random(3)
train=rows*83  # ~9960 windows
job={'fields':fields,'slots':slots,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,

print('time %.2fs rules=%d active=%d' % (dt, len(out['rules']), len(out['active'])))
